summary.en: To end the lease midway, notify the landlord or the real estate agent in writing within the period set in the lease (usually 1 to 2 months in advance; check the lease; to be checked). If you damage or dirty the room willfully or carelessly, you pay the cost of restoring it. The national guideline says that repair costs for wear that comes with time and normal use are included in the rent, and that the tenant's share becomes smaller the longer the building and equipment have been in use. Check the condition of the room carefully at move-in and move-out. The remaining security deposit is returned after the costs are settled. If the lease is unclear, talk with the landlord using the ministry guideline as a reference (to be checked). For trouble, you can consult the foreigner consultation of the local government or the international exchange association. City housing tenants submit the move-out notice to the Nagoya City Housing Supply Corporation office (to be checked). Check the lease and ask the real estate agent (to be checked).
